title: pose
summary: MSUI implements all three current Benilla client-volunteered pose sends. /stand, /sit, /sleep, /lay and /kneel emit exact CMSG_STANDSTATECHANGE u32 bodies, commit UNIT_FIELD_BYTES_1 byte zero locally, and drive local/streamed poses. A grounded idle mount diverts the Jump edge to an empty CMSG_MOUNTSPECIAL_ANIM and local MountSpecial(94), while strict raw-u64 SMSG handling flourishes observed mounts and suppresses self echoes. Sheath sending remains intact.

openItems.text: CMSG_STANDSTATECHANGE never sent - no sit/sleep/kneel; observers read our stand state from UNIT_FIELD_BYTES_1 which never changes
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: added exact 0x0101/u32 sending, Benilla posture aliases, immediate local descriptor commit, and descriptor-driven local/remote sit, sleep, kneel and chair idle poses with focused clinical coverage.

openItems.text: CMSG_MOUNTSPECIAL_ANIM never sent - no mounted space-bar flourish broadcast
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: added the exact empty CMSG writer, grounded idle mount Jump diversion, local mount-child AnimationData 94 one-shot, strict raw-u64 SMSG receive, observer playback, and self-echo suppression.
